# James Kilby — VMware, Homelab & Cloud Infrastructure Notes

> Technical blog by James Kilby — VMware vExpert and Cloud / Infrastructure Architect. In-depth guides on VMware vSphere, VMware Cloud on AWS, homelab infrastructure, self-hosted AI, Cloudflare, Ansible, and storage.

All posts are also available as raw markdown under `https://jameskilby.co.uk/markdown/posts/<slug>.md` and as JSON under `https://jameskilby.co.uk/api/posts/<slug>.json`.

The full content corpus (every post inlined) is available at [https://jameskilby.co.uk/llms-full.txt](https://jameskilby.co.uk/llms-full.txt).
